about: Known failures of review-matrix.js, each with its reason in docs/todo.md (审阅模式, 2026-11-07): Muya moves a footnote definition to the end when the text near it is edited; a paste of two lines into a heading writes block keys into it (Muya); Enter in a setext heading; Ctrl+Shift+Left selecting across a link or bold marks; a table edited in the visual editor is padded as Muya writes it (one revision of its padding left where the caret is); Backspace at a list item start in source mode taken as writing. Take a cell out once it passes (the run says which).
